_about: Lane A (wright-kicad library.rs) lookup tables, compiled in with include_str!. `packages`: an baseline package name (baseline engine/silkscreen/footprints.py CONNECTOR_PACKAGES / _SWITCH_BUILDERS, kicadlib/packages.py) -> the KiCad library footprint the baseline measured it from. `devices`: a part number KiCad has no exact symbol for, or whose symbol leaves Footprint empty -> footprint id. Every id here exists in KiCad 10.0.6's SharedSupport/footprints (checked 2026-10-24). Families PinHeader_1xNN_P2.54mm and JST_PH_<N>P resolve by KiCad's KLC naming in library.rs and need no row.
